def apply_lora(model, rank, alpha, dropout):
    """Freeze base model and inject PEFT LoRA into PaliGemma attention."""
    for param in model.parameters():

    lora_config = LoraConfig(

        bias="none",
    )

    log.info(

    )
    model.print_trainable_parameters()

def cosine_lr(step, warmup_steps, peak_lr, total_steps):
    """Linear warmup then cosine decay to 5% of peak."""
    if step < warmup_steps:
        return peak_lr * (step + 1) / (warmup_steps + 1)
    end_lr = peak_lr * 0.05
    progress = min(1.0, (step - warmup_steps) / max(1, total_steps - warmup_steps))
    return end_lr + (peak_lr - end_lr) * 0.5 * (1 + math.cos(math.pi * progress))

    observation.images = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in observation.images.items()}

#!/bin/bash
# 4-way LoRA retraining on pi0_libero base checkpoint.
# Launches visual/spatial/physical/universal experts on GPU 0-3 in parallel.
#
# Usage:
#   bash scripts/launch_v2_lora_training.sh           # full training (10k steps)
#   bash scripts/launch_v2_lora_training.sh --dry_run  # 2-step validation
#
# Output: checkpoints/v2_lora_{type}_r16/final/
# Logs:   logs/v2_lora_{type}_r16.log

set -euo pipefail

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
cd /root/meta_brain_lora_routing

# ── Configurable variables ──
PI0_CKPT="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/pi0_libero"
OUTPUT_DIR="/root/meta_brain_lora_routing/checkpoints"
RUN_PREFIX="v2_"
LOG_DIR="/root/meta_brain_lora_routing/logs"
EXTRA_ARGS="${*}"   # pass --dry_run or other flags

# ── Pre-flight checks ──
if [ ! -f "${PI0_CKPT}/model.safetensors" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: pi0_libero checkpoint not found at ${PI0_CKPT}/model.safetensors"
    exit 1
fi

GPU_COUNT=$(python3 -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.device_count())")
if [ "${GPU_COUNT}" -lt 4 ]; then
    echo "WARNING: only ${GPU_COUNT} GPUs available, need 4 for parallel training"
    echo "Will run sequentially on available GPUs (cycling gpu_id 0..$(( GPU_COUNT - 1 )))"
fi

mkdir -p "${LOG_DIR}"

echo "============================================"
echo "  v2 LoRA Training on pi0_libero"
echo "  checkpoint: ${PI0_CKPT}"
echo "  output:     ${OUTPUT_DIR}/${RUN_PREFIX}lora_{type}_r16/"
echo "  GPUs:       ${GPU_COUNT} available"
echo "  extra args: ${EXTRA_ARGS:-none}"
echo "============================================"

# ── Common training args ──
COMMON_ARGS="--checkpoint ${PI0_CKPT} \
  --output_dir ${OUTPUT_DIR} \
  --run_prefix ${RUN_PREFIX} \
  --lora_rank 16 \
  --lora_alpha 32 \
  --lr 2e-4 \
  --batch_size 16 \
  --num_train_steps 10000 \
  --warmup_steps 100 \
  --num_workers 4 \
  --wandb_project meta_brain_lora_routing \
  ${EXTRA_ARGS}"

# ── Launch 4 experts ──
TYPES=("visual" "spatial" "physical" "universal")
PIDS=()

for i in "${!TYPES[@]}"; do
    TYPE="${TYPES[$i]}"
    GPU_ID=$(( i % GPU_COUNT ))
    LOG_FILE="${LOG_DIR}/${RUN_PREFIX}lora_${TYPE}_r16.log"

    echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] Launching ${TYPE} on GPU ${GPU_ID} → ${LOG_FILE}"

    nohup python phase1/train_lora_expert.py \
        --perturbation_type "${TYPE}" \
        --gpu_id "${GPU_ID}" \
        ${COMMON_ARGS} \
        > "${LOG_FILE}" 2>&1 &

    PIDS+=($!)
done

echo ""
echo "All 4 jobs launched. PIDs: ${PIDS[*]}"
echo ""
echo "Monitor logs:"
for i in "${!TYPES[@]}"; do
    echo "  tail -f ${LOG_DIR}/${RUN_PREFIX}lora_${TYPES[$i]}_r16.log"
done
echo ""
echo "Wait for all to finish:"
echo "  wait ${PIDS[*]}"

# Wait for all background jobs
wait "${PIDS[@]}"
EXIT_CODE=$?

echo ""
if [ ${EXIT_CODE} -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "=== All 4 LoRA trainings completed ==="
else
    echo "=== Some training jobs failed (exit code: ${EXIT_CODE}) ==="
fi

ls -la "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${RUN_PREFIX}"lora_*_r16/final/ 2>/dev/null
